channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: No Cave Music
item.description: Removes cave music and doesn't stop regular music when entering caves or deep cellars.

item.title: Dragonia Server Mod Patch
item.description: Меняет генерацию железа и добавляет новый крафт льняного шпагата

item.title: Barbershop Plus
item.description: Re-implements Barbershop as a full-fledged profession.

item.title: VS Instruments Redux
item.description: Bring your world to life! Play custom ABC sheet music files on working in-game instruments.

item.title: Ritual Apotheosis
item.description: Build ancient rites from fragments. The world is your altar. Dig deep. Seek truth. Light the fires.

item.title: Spaturno and Trini's Secure Shelter
item.description: Shared extradimensional cottage inspired from D&D spell Leomund's Secure Shelter.

item.title: Magnetic Crown
item.description: Crown that attracts all nearby items

item.title: RKN Generic Crafting
item.description: Generic crafting system that completely replaces the UI grid with a more immersive mechanic

item.title: Loot Goblins BIG Chests
item.description: Increases storage container slots by a bit, not double, just a few extra rows.

item.title: Kobold Taur experimental model
item.description: Modified taur version of Kobold model from Kobold Redux mod by Caliber

item.title: Alt+Tab Spin Fix
item.description: Fix the physics explosion and delta-time ramp up caused by unfocusing the game.

item.title: Stone Bake Oven
item.description: You can create a Stone Bake Oven for all your large baking needs. Now with cooking pot spots!

item.title: Notice Board
item.description: Notice board where you can post and read player notices. Focused on RP aspect.

item.title: Unbind Key
item.description: Press the Delete key to clear the key bindings

item.title: Rock Attac - Armor Protec
item.description: Enables vanilla armor to natively mitigate crushing damage from falling blocks.

item.title: Boat Speed Tweaks
item.description: Multiply Sailboats and Rafts speed by the configured factor, separately (default for both = 2.0)

item.title: Secure Cooking Pots
item.description: No more lost liquids while cooking. You'll get burnt if you try.

item.title: Zoom Button Patch
item.description: Hides the player hands and items held while zooming. No more torch in the way!

item.title: Bricks & Blooms Server Tweaks
item.description: Solves conflicts between various mods for the Bricks and Bloom server.

item.title: Downed
item.description: Replaces the vanilla downed state with a survivable, invulnerable downed state. Quite bloody.

item.title: Smaller jugs handling
item.description: Transfers 0.25L of liquid when moving portions using a jug. The vanilla size is 0.3L.

item.title: UI-Tweaks
item.description: Zoom Button, configurable HUD, in-game calculator, and more...

item.title: Larger jugs handling
item.description: Transfers 0.5L of liquid when moving portions using a jug. The vanilla size is 0.3L.

item.title: Forgotten Armory: Chinese Dynasties
item.description: Mod adding multiple iron+ Scale armor variations in the style of Chinese Dynasties

item.title: NDL ExpandedGrowth (Tree Growth Module)
item.description: Adds a method for growing larger variants of trees.

item.title: The Hunter
item.description: Track prey, follow blood, carry carcasses, compost dung, and have smarter wolves.

item.title: The Gravestones Mod
item.description: Adds a gravestone which stores the players inventory upon death and can be retrieved by them later.

item.title: Science Core
item.description: Мод для разработчиков, добавляющий древа исследований, блокирующий/разблокирующий крафты

item.title: Ding Dong!
item.description: Интерактивные колокола

item.title: Make Tea Forked
item.description: Make clay teapots and mugs, brew tea and drink it.
